newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan early Feb exports down on less working days.
newsitem.headline: Japan early Feb exports down on less working days.

text.p: Exports in the first 10 days of February fell from the same period a year earlier due to there being one less working day than last year, a Finance Ministry official said on Wednesday.

Asked about the 56.1 percent shrinkage in the customs-cleared trade surplus for the period, the official said: "There was one less working day when compared with last year and as result there were less exports and imports. Exports were particularly influenced by this factor."
He added that imports had likely risen due to higher prices.
The ministry said earlier on Wednesday that the customs-cleared trade surplus fell to 83.18 billion yen in the first 10 days of February.
Free-on-board (FOB) exports fell 5.6 percent from a year earlier to 1.16 trillion yen while cost, insurance and freight (CIF) imports rose 3.6 percent to 1.07 trillion yen.
